# Original parser corpus

These 17 small documents replace selected _characteristics_ of the 38-file exploratory corpus with original, redistributable test material. They contain invented prose, data, layouts, diagrams, raster pixels, glyph outlines, XML, and an ICC profile. They do not copy the downloaded documents, their fonts, artwork, text, thumbnails, embedded files, or byte sequences. All generators and original assets in this directory use the repository's MPL-2.0 license. The larger exploratory corpus remains external and is not required to run these tests.

This is characteristic coverage, not a claim of full parity with every feature or production engine in the exploratory corpus. The gaps below are deliberate and visible. In particular, these examples are not certified PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X, Factur-X, or geospatial products, and the mock signature dictionaries do not contain valid signatures.

## Construction and ownership

- `field-notes` and `pixel-postcard` use `PdfDocumentBuilder` to author original pages. The former uses nested page trees, multiple standard fonts, columns, a table, a chart, and rotation. Standard PDF fonts are named, not bundled as font files.
- `wire.ts` is an independent fixture writer for classic tables, predicted cross-reference streams, object streams, hybrid lookup, and incremental revisions. It deliberately does not call Mondrian's serializer. Raw authoring also expresses features the semantic builder does not currently model.
- `glyph-garden` contains three hand-drawn Type 3 glyphs: 山, 三, and ا. One is an original bitmap mask. Its ToUnicode CMap permits PDFium to extract Unicode; it is not an embedded CJK/Arabic font or a shaping test.
- `lantern-archive` generates its raster pixels arithmetically. `color.ts` generates a minimal RGB ICC matrix/shaper profile and every graphics resource from source; it includes no downloaded color profile.
- `garden-raster.jpg` is generated solely from arithmetic RGBA values by `generate-jpeg.ts` and pinned `@napi-rs/canvas` 1.0.9. Its SHA-256 is `7ae5e221d9402478b98c75ab7e59ff041b95123c106ec782ad7e3e9e77fbd625`. Tests read this committed file, rather than regenerating JPEG bytes on different hosts. The generator uses no fonts, network, or external assets.
- The two encrypted tiles reuse this branch's original `../encrypted.ts` fixture and fixed Node/OpenSSL-derived password vectors. They are not derived from the vendor sample. Their fixed keys, IVs, salts, passwords, and signature placeholder are exclusively test data.
- Every document is generated deterministically at test time from these sources. Generated PDFs need not be checked in; reviewed PNG proofs and their manifests are committed beside the private visual tests.

## What the tests establish

[`original-corpus.test.ts`](../../private/original-corpus.test.ts) requires deterministic fixture generation, successful parse and validation with exactly the fixture's intended recovery/date options, presence of expected feature names, complete graph equality after strict reparsing, and deterministic second serialization. Focused checks establish that compressed members have no ordinary object definitions; the incremental catalog changes the effective version; indirect Contents and Info values remain indirect; malformed inputs require opt-in; nonstandard date bytes survive; XML and nested PDF attachments are extractable; and form values, scripts, tags, original bitmap glyphs, ToUnicode data, invisible OCR operators, and ICC bytes survive.

[`visual-regressions/original-corpus.test.ts`](../../private/visual-regressions/original-corpus.test.ts) independently opens both input and output using pinned PDFium, comparing **all 19 pages**, not a sample. Every page's dimensions, rotation, extracted text, and raw pixel SHA-256 must match. Expected geometry and authored text are checked independently of the comparison. The same rewritten pages are compared to reviewed, committed 72 dpi PNG baselines; no pixel tolerance is used. PDFium handles the actual raster and structural filters during this check; Mondrian preserves content/image stream encodings rather than decoding them itself.

All these assertions are private regression checks. Full graph shapes, object numbering, serializer byte choices, diagnostics, and snapshots are not additional semver commitments. Public API compatibility is tested separately.

## Characteristic matrix

“Executed” means the feature changes a visible page, extracted text, decoded structural object, or explicitly extracted attachment in a test. “Preserved” means the graph/bytes are retained without exercising the corresponding interactive or conformance behavior.

| Characteristic observed in the exploratory corpus                                             | Original fixture(s)                                                                                                                                                    | Proof and limits                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PDF headers 1.2 through 1.7 and 2.0                                                           | `glyph-garden` (1.2), `field-notes`/`pixel-postcard` (1.3), `lantern-archive` (1.4), ledger variants (1.5), `cloud-creek-atlas` (1.6), others (1.7), UTF-8/prism (2.0) | Executed by parsing and independent page proof. Version declarations are not conformance certification.                                                                                                                            |
| Classic xref, xref streams, compressed objects, hybrid tables                                 | ordinary fixtures, `streamed-ledger`, `hybrid-ledger`, `parcel-receipt`                                                                                                | Executed: required font/navigation/form objects are compressed; no ordinary definitions can mask a broken object-stream reader. Xref streams use Flate with PNG Up prediction.                                                     |
| Incremental update and catalog version override                                               | `incremental-garden`                                                                                                                                                   | Executed: a 1.4 header gains an effective 2.0 catalog through `/Prev`, while prior page objects remain live. Revision history is intentionally lost when rewritten.                                                                |
| Indirect Contents arrays and indirect Info strings/names                                      | all four `metadata-*` fixtures                                                                                                                                         | Executed: both page streams render, metadata resolves, original indirect relationships survive.                                                                                                                                    |
| UTF-16BE metadata/dates and PDF 2.0 UTF-8 metadata/dates                                      | `metadata-utf16`, `metadata-utf8`                                                                                                                                      | Executed by validator and exact byte/graph preservation. Titles contain Unicode; date encodings remain unchanged.                                                                                                                  |
| Historic date syntax, Quartz-style suffix, zero-offset in-use entries                         | `metadata-historic`, `metadata-quartz`                                                                                                                                 | Executed: strict rejection, explicit preservation/recovery, expected warnings, unchanged date bytes, matching pages. No zero-offset object is invented.                                                                            |
| Header prefix with offsets relative to the PDF header                                         | `prefixed-ticket`                                                                                                                                                      | Executed: strict rejection and explicit recovery of the invented envelope with a warning.                                                                                                                                          |
| Empty-password AES-256 R6 and password-required R5                                            | `encrypted-tile-r6`, `encrypted-tile-r5`                                                                                                                               | Executed: authentication, encrypted object/content streams, plaintext metadata/content graph, and independent PDFium input/output proof. Output is unencrypted. The existing encryption suite covers more parameter/failure cases. |
| Research/report/manual layout, ordinary live text, tables, diagrams                           | `field-notes`                                                                                                                                                          | Executed: every page and text run is proofed. Three pages exercise the nested tree; hundreds of pages and large-file resource behavior are not reproduced.                                                                         |
| JPEG/DCT, Flate, ASCII85, image masks and invisible OCR                                       | `pixel-postcard`, `lantern-archive`, `glyph-garden`                                                                                                                    | Executed: JPEG pixels, an ASCII85→Flate raster, bitmap glyphs, and invisible OCR text are read by PDFium and preserved by Mondrian. This is not codec decoding by Mondrian.                                                        |
| Type 1 and Type 3, Unicode/ToUnicode                                                          | `field-notes`, `glyph-garden`                                                                                                                                          | Executed: original glyph outlines and bitmap glyph render; Unicode extraction matches. PDFium's bidirectional text order is checked. No general shaping/language support is inferred.                                              |
| CMYK, CalRGB, Lab, Indexed, Separation, DeviceN, ICCBased                                     | `prism-workshop`                                                                                                                                                       | Executed in visible swatches; original profile bytes are explicitly compared. Composite pixels do not certify print separations or colorimetric accuracy.                                                                          |
| Transparency groups, blend modes, image and graphics soft masks, patterns, shading, overprint | `prism-workshop`                                                                                                                                                       | Transparency, blend, masks, tiling and axial shading are executed by the page proof. Overprint dictionaries are preserved; no press/separation proof is claimed.                                                                   |
| Document/page output intents and PDF 2.0 black-point-compensation setting                     | `prism-workshop`                                                                                                                                                       | Preserved and render-stable. Neither PDF/X compliance nor the physical color-management effect of output intents/BPC is certified.                                                                                                 |
| Links, outlines, named destinations, tags/structure trees                                     | `streamed-ledger`, `hybrid-ledger`, `parcel-receipt`, `lantern-archive`                                                                                                | Preserved, including references and MCIDs. Text/OCR extraction is executed; navigation, screen readers, accessibility conformance and reading order are not exercised.                                                             |
| AcroForm field, widget appearance, XFA, JavaScript                                            | `parcel-receipt`                                                                                                                                                       | Values, appearance bytes, XFA data, and inert JavaScript are preserved. A static page draws the default field value too. Core PDFium does not run the form-fill environment, XFA, or scripts.                                      |
| Associated XML/PDF files, embedded files, collection/portfolio                                | `parcel-receipt`                                                                                                                                                       | Executed extraction of original XML and a nested original PDF; relationships and collection dictionaries are preserved. No portfolio UI or invoice standard is certified.                                                          |
| Layers, viewport/measurement, large page                                                      | `cloud-creek-atlas`                                                                                                                                                    | The enabled layer renders on an 864×1,296-point page. Geospatial dictionaries are preserved. Toggling layers, coordinate transformations, and a 31 MB payload are not exercised.                                                   |
| Signature dictionary bytes                                                                    | encrypted tiles                                                                                                                                                        | Only a clearly fake `/Sig` dictionary is preserved. This is not parity for signed revision history or signature verification. Rewriting cannot preserve original signed byte ranges.                                               |

## Source-sample mapping

The IDs below identify observations only. No source document or copied content is included. This mapping records why a fixture exists and makes missing parity reviewable; a row does not imply that one small fixture reproduces the source document's complete feature set.

| Exploratory sample ID(s)                        | Original counterpart(s)                                 | Material remaining gap                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `attention`, `resnet`, `bitcoin`                | `field-notes`, `pixel-postcard`                         | Embedded TrueType/CFF/CID fonts, full mathematical typesetting, production-engine diversity                                    |
| `lshort`, `r-intro`                             | `field-notes`, ledger variants                          | Large page/object counts, complete outline hierarchies                                                                         |
| `berkshire-2024`                                | `field-notes`, `metadata-utf16`                         | 150-page scale                                                                                                                 |
| `ipcc-synthesis`                                | `field-notes`, `prism-workshop`                         | Complex infographic layouts                                                                                                    |
| `irs-w9`, `irs-w4`                              | `parcel-receipt`, `incremental-garden`                  | Real form filling, XFA execution, signed revisions                                                                             |
| `uscis-i9`                                      | `parcel-receipt`, `metadata-utf16`                      | Real interactive form/JavaScript behavior                                                                                      |
| `scotus-immunity`, `cfr-title1`                 | `field-notes`, `incremental-garden`                     | Large legal publications and valid signatures                                                                                  |
| `apollo11-plan`, `turing-1936`                  | `lantern-archive`, `metadata-historic`                  | CCITT fax/JBIG2 codecs and large scan collections                                                                              |
| `artemis-presskit`, `yosemite-overview`         | `pixel-postcard`, `prism-workshop`, `cloud-creek-atlas` | JPX images and complex brochure artwork                                                                                        |
| `cs231n-lecture1`, `gwg-output-talk`            | `metadata-quartz`, `prism-workshop`                     | Large slide decks and press proofing                                                                                           |
| `usgs-geospatial`, `usgs-topo-standard`         | `cloud-creek-atlas`                                     | Geospatial interaction, complex engineering data, resource scale                                                               |
| `udhr-chinese`, `japanese-leaflet`, `un-arabic` | `glyph-garden`                                          | Embedded CID/TrueType/CFF font programs, real Arabic shaping and CJK font coverage                                             |
| `pdf20-simple`, `pdf20-incremental`             | `incremental-garden`, `prism-workshop`                  | None for header/catalog-version/current-graph behavior; no PDF 2.0 conformance claim                                           |
| `pdf20-offset-header`                           | `prefixed-ticket`                                       | None for the observed header-relative-prefix recovery behavior                                                                 |
| `pdf20-page-outputintent`, `pdf20-blackpoint`   | `prism-workshop`                                        | Color-management conformance/effect beyond stable rendering                                                                    |
| `pdf20-utf8`                                    | `metadata-utf8`                                         | None for the observed encoded Info/date behavior                                                                               |
| `facturx-invoice`, `tagged-invoice`             | `parcel-receipt`                                        | Factur-X/PDF-A/PDF-UA certification and accessible table semantics                                                             |
| `portfolio`                                     | `parcel-receipt`                                        | Portfolio viewer interactions                                                                                                  |
| `three-dimensional`                             | No corresponding 3D payload                             | Valid PRC/U3D model and interactive 3D are not supplied or claimed                                                             |
| `pdfx4`, `pdfa2`                                | `prism-workshop`, `field-notes`                         | Independent PDF/X/PDF/A validation, embedded fonts                                                                             |
| `tagged-ocr`                                    | `lantern-archive`                                       | PDF/UA certification and screen-reader testing                                                                                 |
| `encrypted-permissions`                         | `encrypted-tile-r6`                                     | No gap for the observed empty-password AES-256/current-page roundtrip; output permission restrictions are intentionally absent |
| `type3-font`                                    | `glyph-garden`                                          | None for the observed Type 3 bitmap-glyph preservation/rendering behavior                                                      |

Other unfilled areas include valid linearization, JPEG 2000/JPX, CCITT, JBIG2, LZW image streams, alternate rendering engines, valid digital signatures, embedded TrueType/CFF fonts, rich media, and parser-only performance/memory or fuzz testing. Existing focused parser tests cover additional structural filters and resource-limit rejection; this corpus does not replace them.

## Running and reviewing

From `packages/mondrian`, with installed workspace dependencies:

```sh
MONDRIAN_PDF_ARTIFACT_MODE=verify pnpm exec vp test run tests/private/original-corpus.test.ts tests/private/visual-regressions/original-corpus.test.ts
```

For an intentional fixture change, run with `MONDRIAN_PDF_ARTIFACT_MODE=update`, inspect every changed PNG, and rerun in verify mode. Regenerate the original JPEG only deliberately with `node tests/fixtures/original-corpus/generate-jpeg.ts`, then review the JPEG, update its recorded hash, and review the affected PDF baseline. CI never downloads the exploratory corpus or regenerates assets.
